terms.gloss: a hawk; any bird of prey of the falcon kind
evidence: Ov. Ars 2.147: ōdimus accipitrem, quia vīvit semper in armīs

terms.comment: Not in Lewis & Short; the vowel is left as Traupman marks it.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 326.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
Ov. Ars 2.147 is quoted in this lexicon’s record “hate”, from the Latinitas loci collections.

phrases.latin: ōdimus accipitrem, quia vīvit semper in armīs
phrases.english: we hate the hawk, because it lives always armed
